assumptions: Timings: beat_audit.audit_timing on fold 0, one call per k and condition with every comparator (each comparator's timing_seconds); observation-only wrappers around the engine's module functions split it, per comparator, into closed-set fits, gallery, permutation test, bootstrap and comparator fit, and time the cell's population record, the window summaries and the input loading and hashing.

Population record: once per cell (also for cells that are not evaluable), linear in the rows of the required segments x users x model seeds. Window summaries: once per k; loading and hashing: once per stream; both linear in input size.

Cost of a cell = folds x (model seeds x pairs x 2 directions x per-component cost + model seeds x comparator fit + permutation test + bootstrap), each from the pilot fold of the same stream type (full features, 8-d features or commands), relation, k and comparator.

Per-component cost scales linearly with the rows per user on the two sides of a pair, the closed-set fits quadratically (RBF-SVM); fold sizes are taken as in the pilot (an overestimate for 2a's folds of three users).
Peak memory scales with input size (rows x dimensions x model seeds) when larger than the pilot's; report writing is not part of the pilot and is checked against the development runs' observed times.
Yang2025 batch: its streams in jobs.json order, each started on the first of the allowed parallel jobs to become free, as frozen-batch runs them.

development_check.rule: The gate's projection against the last completed development run's observed stream times (which include report writing), each compared with the projection of the reductions that run used; the Yang2025 streams of the required reductions are rescaled by the largest observed/projected ratio among the development streams of the same type, never below 1, and checked against the configured limits.
